bullets.text: Heavy overnight rains caused severe waterlogging and sewage mixing in Velachery homes, prompting the Chief Minister to order all in-charge ministers to return to Chennai.
Velachery residents faced major difficulties as continuous rains flooded streets and submerged cars and two-wheelers, requiring the office to monitor drainage clearance operations closely.
Chief Minister Vijay instructed responsible ministers to return to Chennai immediately as heavy rains battered the city, and our office must oversee relief coordination.
Corporation workers engaged in rapid water removal efforts to clear ponded rainwater across Velachery following heavy downpours, which the constituency team must supervise.
Floodwaters successfully receded in Velachery AGS Colony due to prompt action by municipal staff, and the team should ensure such swift responses continue.
The Okkiyam Maduvu drain project is highlighted as a major gamechanger for south Chennai flood mitigation, which our office should track for infrastructure progress.
The IMD issued an orange alert for heavy to very heavy rainfall in districts including Thiruvallur, requiring the district team to maintain high preparedness.
A 16-year-old guest worker lost four fingers in a PVC-cutting machine at a Gummidipoondi SIPCOT factory, prompting an official police probe that our office must monitor.
Lakes in Chennai, Kancheepuram, and Tiruvallur districts are filling up fast due to continuous heavy rains, and district authorities must keep a close watch on water levels.
State-owned NBCC and enterprises plan to announce substantial infrastructure investments for data centres and an AI city at the Vibrant Goa summit, which the portfolio team should observe.
Infosys co-founder SD Shibulal stated that artificial intelligence will drive unprecedented growth across industries over the next decade, signaling key trends for our department.
IISc Bengaluru and the Digital India BHASHINI Division developed AI speech technology for the Sourashtra language, showcasing a milestone our digital services team should note.
